boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's pxi_fifo.c, 0x0205b864..0x0205bbdc: 5 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Read from the highest address down (mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order) it is the file in order: PXI_InitFifo (registers the receive handler on IRQ 0x40000 and handshakes through SUBPINTF), PXI_SetFifoRecvCallback, PXI_IsCallbackReady, PXI_SendWordByFifo and PXIi_HandlerRecvFifoNotEmpty.
Every member touches the FIFO state: the SUBP_FIFO_CNT/SEND/RECV registers, the callback table FifoRecvCallbackTable, or the system work's pxiHandleChecker at 0x027fff88.
TOP EDGE: FSi_CloseFileCommand (0x0205bbdc..0x0205bbe4, `return 0`) begins fs_command_default.c (arm9/FS_CommandDefault), none of which touches that state.
BOTTOM EDGE: PXI_Init (0x0205b858..0x0205b864, src/PXI_Init.c) is pxi_init.c's tail call to PXI_InitFifo, a separate SDK file; below it are cache-flushing list helpers.

BSS: FifoCtrlInit (0x020a7fc4, u16 padded to 4) and FifoRecvCallbackTable (0x020a7fc8, PXI_MAX_FIFO_TAG pointers = 0x80 bytes) are pxi_fifo.c's two file-scope statics, read only by its functions. The table ends exactly where fs_archive.c's arc_list starts (0x020a8048); below FifoCtrlInit, data_020a7fc0 is not referenced from pxi_fifo.c.

bss.evidence: The SDK's `static u16 FifoCtrlInit`, PXI_InitFifo's once-only guard: it tests it and sets it to TRUE (0x0205bae4..0x0205bb00). PXI_InitFifo is its only reader.

The SDK's `static PXIFifoCallback FifoRecvCallbackTable[PXI_MAX_FIFO_TAG]`: PXI_InitFifo clears its 32 entries, PXI_SetFifoRecvCallback stores one, PXIi_HandlerRecvFifoNotEmpty dispatches through it. Only pxi_fifo.c's functions reference it.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows arm9/IRQ.
Built as C, as the SDK's pxi_fifo.c is. The API and its types are the SDK's nitro/pxi/common/fifo.h, in include/nitro/pxi/fifo.h; the system work block is nitro/os/systemWork.h.
The .bss names are the SDK source's: data_020a7fc4 is FifoCtrlInit and data_020a7fc8 is FifoRecvCallbackTable.
This SDK is older than the ntrtwl/NitroSDK copy: PXI_InitFifo installs and enables the receive IRQ before it enables the FIFO, and does not call OS_ResetRequestIrqMask first.
